messages:
maya_fin: Vendor Aurora Arc sent INV-61234 for $9,720. AP flagged MISSING_PO — invoice references contract ARC-2024 but no PO. Vendor says it covers two SOWs and shipping.

oscar_proc: can you attach the invoice and any remittance? if two SOWs we need either two PO refs or a manual exception.

lina_ap: AP auto-match: MATCH_FAIL candidates=[PO-1401, PO-1402] reason=ambiguous_line_allocation; freight unmapped.

dan_engineering: Confirming work spanned SOW-1 (PO-1401) and SOW-2 (change order; no PO). procurement backlog caused missing PO for SOW-2.

oscar_proc: options: ask vendor to reissue with PO refs (preferred) or move to Non-PO Review for manual split and GL sign-off. Payrun Fri — recommend Non-PO now if vendor slow.

procure-bot: PR-5233 created: "Aurora INV-61234 missing PO / split shipping" assigned to procurement-queue.

ap-system: Invoice INV-61234 moved to Non-PO Review. Hold timer 48h. Attach acceptance docs to PR-5233.

lina_ap: provisional GL split: SOW-1 -> GL 5901, SOW-2 -> GL 5902; freight split pro-rata. Approver: lina_ap.

maya_fin: i'll request vendor reissue and include PR-5233 link. if no reissue by EOD Thursday we'll pay via manual split per Lina.

oscar_proc: following up with procurement to issue PO-1403 retroactively for SOW-2. will update PR-5233 when done.

dan_engineering: attached acceptance email to PR-5233 to speed approval.

maya_fin: closing loop when PR-5233 has PO or payment record.
